stages.prompt: Using the prior stage and run evidence, write `company/product-database.csv`. Include columns: category,company_or_product,positioning,target_user,core_pain,pricing_or_monetization,distribution_channel,defensibility,gap_or_white_space,confidence,evidence_or_assumption. Use CSV with a header row and at least 40 rows. Do not invent private information; mark assumptions clearly.

Using the prior stage and run evidence, write `trend-graph.json`. Produce valid JSON with keys: nodes, edges, assumptions, watchlist. Nodes must include id, label, type, confidence, summary, opportunity_relevance. Edges must include source, target, relationship, confidence, rationale. Focus on 2026 indie AI/mobile app and B2B SaaS opportunity themes.

finalOutput.description: Trend graph data for the opportunity atlas

stages.prompt: Using the prior stage and run evidence, write `opportunity-matrix.csv`. Include exactly 20 ranked app or SaaS concepts. Columns: rank,concept,target_user,pain,solution,wedge,monetization,distribution,mvp_scope,technical_feasibility,user_pain_score,willingness_to_pay_score,competition_score,distribution_score,risk_score,overall_score,top_risks,next_validation_step,landing_page_headline. Use CSV with a header row.

Using the prior stage and run evidence, write `thesis.md`. It should be a concise but substantive build/investment thesis for a small indie AI/mobile app studio in 2026. Include: executive thesis, strongest opportunity clusters, why now, what to avoid, recommended portfolio of 5 bets, validation plan, 30/60/90-day build roadmap, and caveats.

Using the prior stage and run evidence, write `weekly-update-feed.md`. Create a maintainable update-feed template plus an initial issue. Include sections: signal digest, new products to watch, pricing/monetization changes, distribution-channel signals, funding/patent/research signals, opportunity score changes, experiments to run this week, and stale assumptions to revisit.
